title: gradient.rs: Panic when table created with max_entries=0
description: Line 237: When GradientTable::new(0) is called and then update() is invoked, the condition `self.entries.len() >= self.max_entries` evaluates to `0 >= 0` (true), causing `self.entries.remove(0)` to panic on the empty vector. Fix by either asserting max_entries > 0 in new(), or guarding the remove with a len > 0 check.
